response.sql:
WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally,
         tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share,
         1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat AS status,
       tally,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each QC record represents one project tally; the request does not specify deduplicating projects, and scanqc has no uniqueness constraint on arcref.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct projects per archival status, assigning each project to the status on its QC records; projects with multiple statuses may be counted in multiple groups.
alternatives.sql:
WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally,
         tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share,
         1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat AS status,
       tally,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share;
